title: sertula infesta
intro: Sertula infesta, commonly known as burnweed, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sertula infesta include analgesic, anti-oxidant, and anti-proliferative effects, which may help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and prevent cancer cell growth. The bioactive constituents of Sertula infesta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
